priorityList: Cast Deep Breath once the enemies are grouped up
Cast Eternity Surge at either rank 1 or matching the amount of targets
Cast Disintegrate after casting your empowers to trigger Mass Disintegrate on different targets
Cast Pyre after channeling Mass Disintegrate when fighting 4 or more enemies
Cast Azure Strike as a filler to generate Essence Burst procs to spend on Pyre
Cast Living Flame when you have stacks of Leaping Flames up from casting Fire Breath to gain Essence Burst
Cast empowered spells on cooldown and avoid overcapping Essence
